name: Bonci Pizzarium
headsUp: This is for the Italy branch only, the franchise locations in the US are not in the same league unfortunately.
teaser: Another holy place near Vatican City. Outrageous pizza by the slice (or cut in this case) that is truly close to god.
address: Via della Meloria, 43, 00136 Roma RM, Italy
review: This is the best al taglio (long, rectangular pizza baked in pans with an assortment of cheffy toppings and cut to order) pizza I've ever had. Incredible bread, impeccable toppings, inventive combinations.
